content.text: Digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-costing-2|COREMERCH guide to creators]] in regions with restricted payment platforms face significant challenges when building an online store. Countries like Nigeria and Venezuela often find conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal unavailable, leaving creators without a viable solution. COREMERCH addresses this issue with a robust [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-without-teachable-stripe-explained-digital-creators-4|Selling Courses]]-design-assets-crypto-payments-10|infrastructure]] that enables you to deploy a fully functional crypto store using Cloudflare Pages, allowing you to sell digital products without dependence on traditional platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When payment platforms fail, it is the underlying infrastructure that determines success. COREMERCH’s solutions leverage decentralized technologies, allowing you to bypass conventional payment barriers. With Cloudflare Pages, you gain a reliable hosting solution, while NOWPayments enables seamless cryptocurrency transactions. This self-sovereign architecture ensures that you maintain full control over your store and customer data. Unlike platforms that can restrict access, this infrastructure empowers you to operate independently, regardless of external financial policies.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, you’ll need several components: a Cloudflare account, a Supabase account, and access to NOWPayments. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script as it will handle backend logic efficiently. You will also need your digital products ready for upload, whether they are ebooks, software, or templates. Preparing these elements ensures a smooth deployment process. With the Sovereign Blueprint in hand, you can deploy your store rapidly, ideally within 4-6 hours for Stack 01 or 48 hours for the more comprehensive Stack 02.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The first step in your setup is configuring your NOWPayments account. Choose your preferred cryptocurrencies and set up the webhook to receive instant payment notifications. Next, develop your backend logic using Google Apps Script to handle order processing and manage product delivery. Integrate your cloud storage (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2) for file hosting, ensuring that customers receive their purchases immediately after confirming payment. This combination guarantees a seamless transaction experience that is critical for maintaining customer trust.
Control your data and payment processes without the risk of platform dependency.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment pipeline is configured, conduct thorough testing to ensure everything functions as intended. Use test transactions to validate your payment flow and product delivery system. After confirming successful test runs, it's time to go live. Promote your store using the link to your products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Monitor your transactions closely during this initial phase to address any potential issues promptly. The goal is to ensure a smooth launch that provides customers with an optimal purchasing experience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store live, the focus shifts to scaling your operations. Start by analyzing customer feedback and transaction data to identify areas for improvement. You can add more digital products as your inventory grows. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for advanced features such as SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations and enhanced security measures. This step not only fortifies your infrastructure but also positions you for greater sales opportunities. Keep your store's performance under review, ensuring it adapts to increasing traffic and product demand.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free by using Cloudflare Pages in combination with NOWPayments and Google Apps Script. This setup enables you to host your store and process transactions without relying on traditional payment processors. By following the COREMERCH deployment guide, you can establish a self-sufficient e-commerce environment tailored to your needs.
Deploy in as little as 4-6 hours with Stack 01 for rapid setup.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a comprehensive deployment solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which provides an end-to-end tested setup in just 48 hours. This includes Cloudflare Pages and Workers, along with Supabase for data management. For more details on your options, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a Cloudflare account and configure your domain. Set up a Supabase account for data storage. Register with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. Prepare your digital products for upload. Write backend logic using Google Apps Script. Integrate your chosen storage solution for file delivery. Test the entire pipeline with dummy transactions. Launch your store and promote it to potential customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free by using Cloudflare Pages for hosting, combined with NOWPayments for transaction processing. This approach eliminates reliance on traditional payment systems and allows you to maintain full control over your sales.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, allowing for quick setup in 4-6 hours. Stack 02, however, employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, offering a more robust solution deployed in 48 hours, complete with enhanced features like end-to-end testing.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent hosting solutions for a digital product store. They offer the necessary infrastructure to support your e-commerce needs while allowing you to accept crypto payments through NOWPayments.
What payment methods can I use with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse customer base. This flexibility ensures that you can accept payments in the currency that best suits your audience.
How do I ensure my digital store is secure?

To secure your digital store, implement best practices such as configuring SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email security, using HTTPS, and conducting regular security audits. Investing in a robust infrastructure like the Edge Commerce Stack can also enhance your store's security.
